title: aap-managed-original/v1
description: Durable allocation and version-pinned evidence for Assets source producers. Each producer allocates one immutable locator before physical I/O, writes or adopts it under a conditional creation, reads the exact saved version back in full, records the proof, and only then may publish its business item.
invariants: begin resolves the current datasets binding and refuses a connection-backed binding while owner completion paths keep unprefixed item locators
begin reserves exactly one (storage_identity,bucket,object_key) and never returns a caller-chosen bucket or key
record only advances allocated to verified with matching sha256/md5/size/etag/version readback evidence and a durable storage operation
failed, conflict and unknown outcomes retain the reserved locator and never publish an item
dataset item insert is refused unless the matching creation is verified and its digest matches the item
dataset_asset_locations is written with the verified creation id, storage_ref and exact etag
